issues.field: date the claim was reported (email date)
issues.evidence: Customer email header: 'Customer email received on 2026-10-11'; body: 'I was too busy with work to report it earlier, sorry for the delay.' No source shows any report on 2026-10-03.

issues.field: referral to a claims handler / automatic payment
issues.recorded: status pending_approval with payout €350 staged for automatic approval (assessor required: no, no handler referral)
issues.should_be: Claim must be referred to a Veridia claims handler, not paid automatically
issues.evidence: Contract Article 4.1 (claim must be reported within 5 days of the incident; incident 2026-10-02, reported 2026-10-11 = 9 days) and Article 7.1 ('a claim reported after the deadline in Article 4.1' is referred to a claims handler, who takes the decision; 'a late claim is never refused automatically').

verdict.summary: All other recorded facts check out (C2 collision is in the Policy Schedule, incident 2026-10-02, €650 repair cost, policyholder at fault, no third party so the commercial-vehicle playbook rule does not apply, both required C2 documents attached, no exclusion, €300 deductible and €350 payout consistent since the not-at-fault waiver needs a non-fault driver and the €650 cost is below the €1,500 assessor threshold), but the report date is recorded as 2026-10-03 when the email was actually received on 2026-10-11, i.e. 9 days after the incident, past the 5-day deadline in Article 4.1, so under Article 7.1 the claim must be referred to a handler and must not be paid automatically.
